details:
This update for coredns fixes the following issues:

Changes in coredns:

- Update to version 1.14.7:
  * plugin/acl, plugin/cache, plugin/file, plugin/forward, plugin/kubernetes:
    assorted correctness fixes (stale-cache races, AXFR zone contamination,
    DoH health-check TLS config, failover counter reset, ACL bypass via
    autopath).
  * New: plugin/shed (UDP overload protection), plugin/tls (ACME DNS-01),
    plugin/timeouts maxtcpqueries, DoQ connection-level concurrency limits.
- CVE-2026-41178: go.opentelemetry.io/otel/baggage header parsing did not
  reject excessively large raw values, allowing a denial of service via
  oversized input; fixed by the otel bump to v1.44.0 pulled in with
  this update (boo#1276712)
